On an investigation done by DRI, it was found that company availed excess MEIS benefit of 3% instead of 2% due to inadvertently misclassification of goods. Consequently, the Company basis expert view, had assessed a liability for the differential amount to be refunded for the period from 1 April 2015 till 31 December 2019 amounting to Rs. 907 lakhs (including interest 130 lakhs) which was voluntarily deposited during 2020-21. However, DRI issued show cause notice dated 28 December 2020 under the Custom Act, 1962 imposing penalty of equivalent amount. DRI appointed additional Director General (Adjudication), DRI, New Delhi as common adjudicating authority.In 2022, additional Director General (Adjudication), DRI, New Delhi was re-designated as Commissioner of Custom (Adjudication) Delhi as per notification no 23/2022-cus(nt) dated 31.03.2022.
